ls5_sandstone_diagnostic.decision: Measured two fixed wall windows, 2172 lights and 15264 valid samples per light per window. Top three lamps (307,12..14,255,4440) fall from 12.3–13.1 percent per lamp under Camera to 0.342–0.363 percent under Anchor75. One broad mostly-behind containing sibling takes 82.7 percent at the affected split. A single conditional near-only expansion moves point variance from about 35.7 to 4.92 times Camera offline; 28 prior point windows are near unchanged (worst 1.000274 times anchor). Broad unconditional floors have large regressions; no whole-image or timing conclusion yet.

No screen/performance acceptance.
